import pandas as pd

data = {
    "visit": ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"],
    "wait_minutes": [12, None, 6, 18, 9, 15],
    "consult_minutes": [8, 20, 14, None, 11, 7],
    "note": ["routine", "routine", None, "routine", "routine", "routine"],
    "service": ["Remote", "Clinic", "Clinic", "Remote", "Clinic", "Remote"],
}

import seaborn as sns

selected = df.dropna(subset=["wait_minutes", "consult_minutes"])
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
sns.scatterplot(data=selected, x="wait_minutes", y="consult_minutes", ax=ax)
